say: Your own playlists, on an airplane seatback screen?
New on November 5: your Spotify login on United seatbacks.
Join the plane's Wi-Fi, no pass needed, then scan the QR code.
Your playlists and podcasts appear, right where you left off.
Your password never touches the screen; it logs out after the flight.
The catch: only United planes with Starlink for now, but more are coming.
